note: Literature reports adult STISS patients displaying facial evolution during growth, obesity developing after late childhood, and acne.

evidence.text: In a study of six patients (including four adults) with PSMD12 variants, facial appearance evolved during growth, and most subjects presented with acne and developed obesity beginning in late childhood.

source.title: Does It Run in Your Family? Inherited Truncating  PSMD12  Variants Broaden the Phenotypic Spectrum of Stankiewicz‐Isidor Syndrome
source.quote: Facial appearance evolved during growth: as an adolescent, she … Most subjects had acne, short stature, and developed obesity since late childhood.
